title: StrategyConsolidatedPortfolio
description: Standardized Tier 4 Consolidated Strategy Portfolio & Option C Master Executive Dashboard Contract.

strategy_id.description: Identifier of the Investment Way matching config/investment_ways.yaml (e.g. fundamental_lts).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the master portfolio consolidation was executed.

base_currency.description: Consolidated strategy base currency (e.g. INR or USD).

total_strategy_equity.description: Consolidated portfolio terminal valuation (blended equities + pooled cash) in base currency.

total_invested_capital.description: Total invested purchase cost across all portfolio assets in base currency.

unrealized_pnl.description: Absolute net unrealized profit and loss in base currency.

unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Percentage unrealized profit and loss relative to invested capital.

xirr.description: Annualized True Strategy XIRR percentage (or null if sub-annual guardrail triggered).

portfolio_health_score.description: Weighted average composite health score across non-disqualified holdings.

total_positions.description: Total count of active portfolio securities.

disqualified_count.description: Count of holdings immediately disqualified by the gatekeeper.

needs_review_count.description: Count of holdings flagged by the asymmetric downside guardrail (any Strong Sell).

approved_count.description: Count of holdings passing all gatekeeper and downside checks (HOLD, BUY, STRONG_BUY).

capital_at_risk.description: Total monetary market value of positions with DISQUALIFIED or NEEDS_REVIEW stance.

blended_holdings.description: Consolidated blended positions contract from holding-blender.

performance.description: True Strategy XIRR and itemized friction accounting report from strategy-xirr.

verdict_synthesis.description: Downside guardrail synthesis and allocation rebalancing report from guardrail-engine.

embedded_audits.description: Option C embedded valuation and forensic governance audits keyed by security ticker.
